actions.description: Capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference.
actions.name: capture_image

facts.text: The node constructor names the node 'raspicam2' in the 'camera' namespace.
The constructor always creates a sensor_msgs::msg::CompressedImage publisher on the relative topic 'image/compressed' with QoS depth 1.
The constructor creates a sensor_msgs::msg::CameraInfo publisher on the relative topic 'image/camera_info' with QoS depth 1.
The compressed-image callback stamps a header, sets format to 'jpeg', and publishes the encoded bytes on the compressed-image publisher.
The compressed-image callback also stamps and publishes the CameraInfo message after each compressed frame.
CameraInfo width and height are copied from the configured width and height ROS parameters before capture starts.
The constructor seeds the width, height, fps and JPEG quality parameters with 320, 240, 90 and 80; these are ROS parameter defaults, not device bounds.
The shipped parameter file selects image_transport 'compressed', width 320, height 240, fps 90 and JPEG quality 80 as an example deployment configuration.
The constructor defaults image_transport to 'raw' and creates the raw sensor_msgs::msg::Image publisher only when that parameter equals 'raw'.
The raw Image callback sets the rgb8 encoding, dimensions and byte data but never sets Image.step; the package does not use that malformed raw publication.
The set_camera_info service copies the request camera_info into the member and returns success=true; it performs no optical calibration or hardware control.
The constructor calls init_cam and start_capture, and the destructor calls close_cam.
README marks the package deprecated because the MMAL rawcam component is legacy and points deployments to camera_ros instead.
The build searches for MMAL, mmal_core, mmal_util, mmal_vc_client, vcos and bcm_host libraries under /opt/vc and includes /opt/vc/include.
